note: Shelby County TX publishes no county zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The largest city, Center, publishes its zoning only as a static 2025 PDF zoning map (centertexas.org/sites/default/files/2025zoningmap.pdf) and says it uses ArcGIS internally but exposes no queryable zoning service. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the web found no zoning district polygon service for Shelby County or Timpson, Tenaha, Joaquin or Shelbyville. Only parcel/ESN/fire-area layers (DETCOG) and paid shapefiles exist.
